Page.Title: Breadcrumbs
Page.Subtitle: The path to the current place: links separated by chevrons, the last item is where the user is. When they do not fit, the first ones give their place to an ellipsis. The header of this app uses one.

Demo.Title: Breadcrumb
Demo.Note: Click an item to go back to it (Rbreadcrumb_truncate); add more to see the ellipsis.
